 * Generated by semaprax::public_generic_consumer::cxx_calling.
 * Compiler-generated deterministic output; do not edit.
 *
 * A move-only C++17 RAII wrapper around the generated C11 calling consumer
 * (issue #158, spx_pg_calling_consumer.h/.c). This file WRAPS that C11
 * client: it never restates its codec, its lifecycle, or its pairing check,
 * and it never names a native ABI provider handle type (that stays entirely
 * inside spx_pg_calling_consumer.c, behind the opaque consumer handle).
 * Existing C and public profiles remain unchanged: this header calls only
 * the closed C11 surface spx_pg_calling_consumer.h already declares.
 *
 * Move-only is the crux, not decoration: Provider and Output below delete
 * their copy constructor/assignment, are noexcept move-constructible and
 * move-assignable, and release their sole owned handle at most once, in a
 * noexcept destructor, via a private idempotent reset()/free helper. See
 * docs/PUBLIC-GENERIC-CONSUMERS-V1.md's C++17 calling consumer section for
 * the exact zero-leak evidence and whose counters it uses.
 */
#ifndef SEMAPRAX_PUBLIC_GENERIC_CONSUMER_V1_HPP
#define SEMAPRAX_PUBLIC_GENERIC_CONSUMER_V1_HPP

#include "spx_pg_calling_consumer.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>

namespace semaprax::public_generic::v1 {

/* A non-owning, C++17-only view (deliberately not the C++20 span facility).
 * Valid only while the Output that produced it remains live and unmoved --
 * restated once here rather than on every accessor. */
struct BytesView {
    const std::uint8_t *data = nullptr;
    std::size_t size = 0;
};

/* An explicit, independent copy of a view's bytes. The returned vector
 * shares no storage with the Output the view came from and remains valid
 * after that Output is moved, released, or destroyed. */
inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> to_owned(const BytesView &view) {
    if (view.size == 0) {
        return {};
    }
    return std::vector<std::uint8_t>(view.data, view.data + view.size);
}

/* Closed error vocabulary. Every failure this wrapper can report maps to
 * exactly one of these -- restating spx_pg_calling_consumer.h's own closed
 * spx_pg_consumer_status vocabulary (see map_error_kind below) rather than
 * inventing an independent one; a new reason requires a new C11 status
 * first. AllocationFailure and NullArgument extend the illustrative set
 * this generator's owning issue sketched, so every non-OK C11 status has an
 * exact typed home. ReleaseFailed reports an explicit native cleanup failure
 * only when no earlier operation failed; Error retains release_status as
 * secondary evidence when an export/decode/allocation failure won first. */
enum class ErrorKind : std::uint32_t {
    DescriptorRejected,
    ProviderMismatch,
    CarrierRejected,
    CapacityExceeded,
    ExecutionFailed,
    ResultRejected,
    ReleaseFailed,
    AllocationFailure,
    NullArgument,
};

/* A closed, typed failure: the mapped ErrorKind plus the raw native
 * spx_pg_status_v1 an ExecutionFailed restates (0 for every other kind, or
 * for a native status this wrapper's own checks caught locally) -- restating
 * spx_pg_consumer_transform's own out_native_status parameter. Never a
 * string: no reason here is ever parsed from prose. */
class Error final {
public:
    Error(ErrorKind kind, int native_status, int release_status = 0) noexcept
        : kind_(kind), native_status_(native_status), release_status_(release_status) {}

    ErrorKind kind() const noexcept { return kind_; }
    int native_status() const noexcept { return native_status_; }
    int release_status() const noexcept { return release_status_; }

private:
    ErrorKind kind_;
    int native_status_;
    int release_status_;
};

/* Restates spx_pg_calling_consumer.h's own closed spx_pg_consumer_status
 * vocabulary exhaustively: every non-OK status maps to exactly one
 * ErrorKind. SPX_PG_CONSUMER_OK and any status this header does not define
 * fall back to ExecutionFailed rather than undefined behavior -- a status
 * this consumer's own header does not declare cannot occur from a real
 * call, but this function never assumes that by omission. */
inline ErrorKind map_error_kind(::spx_pg_consumer_status status) noexcept {
    switch (status) {
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_DESCRIPTOR_REJECTED:
        return ErrorKind::DescriptorRejected;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_PROVIDER_MISMATCH:
        return ErrorKind::ProviderMismatch;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_CARRIER_REJECTED:
        return ErrorKind::CarrierRejected;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED:
        return ErrorKind::CapacityExceeded;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_EXECUTION_FAILED:
        return ErrorKind::ExecutionFailed;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_RESULT_REJECTED:
        return ErrorKind::ResultRejected;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_ALLOCATION_FAILURE:
        return ErrorKind::AllocationFailure;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_RELEASE_FAILED:
        return ErrorKind::ReleaseFailed;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_NULL_ARGUMENT:
        return ErrorKind::NullArgument;
    case SPX_PG_CONSUMER_OK:
    default:
        return ErrorKind::ExecutionFailed;
    }
}

/* C++17 has no std::expected. A closed, typed, exception-free result: either
 * a value of T or an Error, never both, never neither. No public method
 * exposes the discriminant as anything but has_value()/operator bool -- a
 * caller cannot forge a value out of an error state or vice versa. */
template <typename T>
class Result final {
public:
    Result(T value) noexcept : storage_(std::move(value)) {}
    Result(Error error) noexcept : storage_(std::move(error)) {}

    bool has_value() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<T>(storage_); }
    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return has_value(); }

    T &value() & noexcept { return std::get<T>(storage_); }
    const T &value() const & noexcept { return std::get<T>(storage_); }
    T &&value() && noexcept { return std::get<T>(std::move(storage_)); }

    const Error &error() const noexcept { return std::get<Error>(storage_); }

private:
    std::variant<T, Error> storage_;
};
